resources.string: Allow Just Notes to install updates, then come back and tap Update.
Confirm the installation in Android\'s dialog.
The update could not be installed.
The download stopped. Check the internet connection and tap Retry.
The phone blocked it. On Samsung: Settings → Security and privacy → Auto Blocker → Off, then tap Retry.
The installed app was signed differently. Uninstall it once and install the new one; your chats and notes are on the server.
Not enough free space. Free some storage and tap Retry.
The installation was cancelled. Tap Retry and choose Install.
Tap Retry. If it fails again, turn off Auto Blocker (Samsung) and check free space.
